messages:
sara: Support flagged a customer hitting repeated 504s and 5xxs for hosted inference. p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 3s around 17:01 UTC. Customers: AcmeAnalytics, BrightDoc. :grimacing:

devon: seeing the same in dashboards. request-queue depth climbed to 98% of configured max (1024). dequeue rate dropped, continuous-batcher backlog growing.

jamal: logs show a pattern — lots of long-sequence requests arriving, causing KV cache spinups and CPU pressure on the batchers. sample from node-12: ```ERR dequeue timeout after 1500ms; batcher backlog=378; inflight_kv_spin=4; cpu=92%```

li: any recent deploys? could be change to batching window or grace-window tuning.

devon: rolled a tiny router optimization at 16:50 but it was a config flip (max_batch_latency_ms=8 -> 6). rollback in progress now.

sara: ack. I'm fielding customer SLAs. Need ETA and mitigation steps.

jamal: short term: 1) temporarily raise request-queue-depth to 2048 for hosted pool A 2) enable forced-dequeue on oldest requests for 30s window 3) scale dedicated batcher count +1. That should relieve tail buildup.

li: can we also disable cold-path KV spinups by pinning small recent-models cache? toggling kv_spin_threshold -> inf would stop spinups but need careful rollback.

devon: applying queue-depth bump to pool A now. patch submitted: "increase-ingress-depth-ephemeral". ops-bot: deploy requested.

ops-bot: deploy started by devops-ci (deploy id: d-83f2). rolling to pool A (3 nodes) — ETA ~2m. :hammer_and_wrench: 

sara: telling customers we have an active mitigation and rolling a config change.

jamal: after bump we still see occasional tail spikes, but dequeue rate recovers. Looks like long-seq jobs still hogging batchers and preventing efficient batching. We should patch router to prefer short requests to keep tail latency down.

devon: agreed. adding a short-request-priority flag to routing policy for canary (5% traffic) to validate.

li: created canary route: route-priority=short-first, canary=5%. If stable for 10m, we can roll.

ops-bot: deploy succeeded to pool A (deploy id d-83f2).

jamal: metrics: p95 down from 3s -> 220ms after queue bump + scale. p99 still ~1.4s due to a few longseq tails.

sara: customers updated, one reduced their escalation. still have follow-ups from BrightDoc.

devon: patch to routing policy is healthy in canary. starting gradual traffic shift.

li: follow-up action items: - run a short/long seq replay against staging to reproduce tail saturation - add telemetry for kv_spin events per-request - consider per-tenant longseq isolations for Dedicated tier

jamal: adding a temporary alert rule: if continuous-batcher backlog > 200 and queue-depth > 85% for > 2m -> page eng-sre.

sara: thanks. I'll open a support ticket and include the mitigation summary and timeline.

devon: leaving notes for postmortem: root cause likely interplay between tighter batch latency config + burst of long-sequence customer jobs -> KV spinups -> CPU contention -> dequeue stalls. fix: route prioritization + elastic queue depth + longseq isolation.

li: creating a follow-up RFC to formalize longseq handling and a canary plan for routing priority.

sara: closing customer-facing incident once BrightDoc verifies reduced errors. will follow up on the RFC. :white_check_mark:
